title: BAHU - Bio-Automation & Human User Interface
text: BAHU is the local operating and orchestration layer beneath the AMReye.AI brand. It gives one human-facing interface to AST, MIC, incubation, imaging, gas control, robotics, liquid handling, QC, research protocols and instrument integrations.
tables: Builds approved clinical workflows from locked steps and research workflows from permissioned modules.
Coordinates plate queues, imaging cadence, incubation windows, liquid tasks and maintenance.
Maps vendor APIs, serial devices, OPC-UA/MQTT services or file interfaces into a common command/event model.
Stops, parks or reroutes work on barcode mismatch, calibration lapse, environment excursion or robotic fault.
Shows raw evidence, boundaries, QC, rule version and uncertainty before confirm/edit/reject.
Records who did what, when, on which device/software/model/rule version.
Links protocol, samples, conditions, images, analysis and annotations to a reproducible experiment record.
